# Uni-Verso693 (Universo693 SpA)

> Uni-Verso693 is the brand of Universo693 SpA, an established Chilean software engineering and artificial intelligence consulting company founded in 2013. Led by Founder and Principal Solutions Architect Alexis Santana M., the studio designs, builds, and operates custom software platforms, autonomous AI agents (WhatsApp API, web, CRM), mobile apps (iOS, Android, PWA), e-commerce systems, and cloud infrastructure.
>
> Core philosophy: 100% Technological Sovereignty (clients own 100% of their source code, repositories, domains, and credentials without agency vendor lock-in via the Client Digital Vault), zero recurring per-user/student software licensing fees, and a 60-day post-launch technical warranty on every project.
>
> Official website: https://universo693.com
> Full Documentation for LLMs: https://universo693.com/llms-full.txt

## Company Facts
- Legal name: Universo693 SpA (RUT 78.521.951-1)
- Also known as: Universo693, UniVerso693, Estudio UniVerso693
- Founded: 2013 (+12 years of software engineering track record)
- Track record: +50 cloud projects and software systems in production across 14 industry sectors.
- Country: Chile. Remote-first engineering studio based in Viña del Mar / Santiago, serving corporate clients across Chile, Latin America, the United States, and Europe.
- Languages: Spanish and English (bilingual engineering and support).
- Group structure: Universo693 is the holding entity; its spin-offs include YndiPet (yndipet.com) and MEMORA (memora.lat). Uni-Verso693 itself develops high-impact custom software, AI agents, and cloud platforms for business clients.
- Work culture: Direct engineering communication without account manager middlemen or anonymous help desks. Clients collaborate directly with the solutions architect and developers.
- Pricing model: Transparent, fixed-cost milestones based on technical scope. Every project includes turnkey handover, full repository transfer, 60-day warranty, and sovereign credentials in the Client Digital Vault.
- Client Digital Vault (Bóveda Digital, $0): Centralized encrypted portal at https://universo693.com/boveda. Features interactive kickoff onboarding ("Configuración & Recepción de Insumos") with institutional access keys, plus 24/7 sovereign access to client database credentials, dedicated servers, DNS records, private GitHub repositories, and API keys. Included at $0 in all projects as an anti-vendor-lock-in guarantee.
- Direct contact: Form at https://universo693.com/contacto · WhatsApp +56 9 9038 7414 · Email contacto@universo693.com · Direct engineer reply in less than 2 hours.

## Master Services Catalog
- [Custom Software Development](https://universo693.com/servicios/software-a-medida): Scalable web platforms, internal intranets, B2B portals, microservices, high-performance REST/GraphQL APIs, ERP/CRM bi-directional sync, and automated transactional workflows. Modern tech stack: React, TypeScript, Node.js, Next.js, Python, PostgreSQL, Redis, and Docker.
- [AI Agents & Cognitive Automation](https://universo693.com/servicios/agentes-ia): Autonomous AI agents with advanced RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) and Function Calling architecture. Trained strictly on company manuals, technical documentation, and product catalogs with zero hallucinations. Live integration with official WhatsApp Business API, web chat, and CRMs; capable of real-time quoting, inventory lookup, Google Calendar scheduling, and automatic human hand-off.
- [Virtual Campuses & LMS (SENCE + AI)](https://universo693.com/servicios/campus-virtuales): Proprietary corporate e-learning and OTEC training platforms. Unlimited students, unlimited courses, and zero recurring per-user licensing fees (disrupting traditional Moodle/Canvas recurring seat pricing). Features an integrated 24/7 AI Virtual Tutor trained on course manuals and standards (NFPA, ISO, NCh 2728), offline-capable mobile PWA, interactive evaluations, and automated audit logs.
- [Government & Public Integrations](https://universo693.com/servicios/integraciones-gob): Native engineering integrations with Chilean public infrastructure:
  * SENCE: Direct API / Web Services SENCE integration for real-time Libro de Clases Digital, biometric presence verification, and automated SENCE-compliant QR attendance diplomas.
  * ClaveÚnica (Gobierno Digital / Segpres): Official citizen SSO authentication for verified student and instructor login.
  * SII: Electronic Invoicing (DTE) emission, reception, and tax compliance automation.
- [Payment Gateways & Fintech](https://universo693.com/servicios/pasarelas-pago): Enterprise integration with Chilean and international processors: Transbank Webpay Plus, Mercado Pago, Flow.cl, Fintoc (Open Banking / direct bank transfers), Khipu, and Stripe. Built with idempotent asynchronous webhooks, automated transaction reconciliation, and zero checkout drop-offs.
- [Technical SEO & High-Performance Web](https://universo693.com/servicios/seo-tecnico): Deep search engine optimization for React/SPA architectures using Static Site Generation (SSG), prerendering, Core Web Vitals (<1.0s LCP, zero layout shifts), semantic schema markup (JSON-LD), and automated sitemap pipelines.
- [Mobile Apps & PWA](https://universo693.com/servicios/apps-moviles): High-performance cross-platform applications for iOS, Android, and Progressive Web Apps (PWA). Includes offline-first sync, push notifications, hardware access (GPS, camera/barcode scanning), and smooth 60 FPS interfaces.
- [Cloud Migrations & Data Resilience](https://universo693.com/servicios/migraciones-cloud): Zero-downtime migrations from legacy VPS/on-premise to modern AWS, Google Cloud, or DigitalOcean cloud architectures. Containerized with Docker, automated daily point-in-time backups, SSL TLS 1.3 with HSTS, and 99.95% uptime SLA.
- [Technology Consulting & Architecture](https://universo693.com/servicios/consultoria): Enterprise software blueprints, code audits, cybersecurity assessments, and digital transformation roadmaps for corporate leadership.
- [Client Sovereign Vault & Interactive Onboarding](https://universo693.com/boveda): Centralized, bank-grade encrypted portal (AES-256) where clients manage their kickoff requirements ("Configuración & Recepción de Insumos") with institutional access keys, and maintain permanent 24/7 ownership over their GitHub repositories, PostgreSQL databases, cloud infrastructure, DNS records, and API tokens. 100% anti-vendor lock-in guarantee.

## EBS 693 AI Diagnosis in Detail (https://universo693.com/diagnostico-ia)
EBS 693 is a strategic operational diagnosis for businesses that turns tech uncertainty into an interactive, prioritized roadmap with estimated ROI.
- Designed for business owners: Transport, logistics, clinics, retail, manufacturing, agriculture, and service companies looking to automate manual tasks (Excel spreadsheets, repetitive phone calls, dispatch notes) without getting lost in technical jargon.
- Format: 45-minute remote Google Meet session for $197,000 CLP.
- Zero-risk guarantee: The $197,000 CLP fee is 100% credited toward the project if the client moves forward with Uni-Verso693 (making the diagnosis effectively $0).
- Deliverables:
  1. Operational x-ray identifying money leaks and repetitive bottlenecks.
  2. Prioritized technical roadmap ranked by impact vs. effort.
  3. Private interactive space (expires in 30 days, not indexed by search engines) with the client's logo, where they adjust business numbers live ("what if") and view recalculating payback and 12-month ROI.
  4. Visual before-and-after process flows and executive PDF report.
- Live demo with transport fleet data (200 trucks): https://universo693.com/ebs/demo

## Audit 693 (https://universo693.com/audit-693)
- Free instant tool: In ~20 seconds analyzes the home page of a company's website and displays 3 immediate AI and automation opportunities on screen.
- AUDIT 693 PRO ($19,990 CLP in Chile / USD 21 internationally): Full PDF report analyzing up to 7 web pages, local competitor benchmarks, exact monthly and annual cost of manual hours, and 8-10 prioritized automation opportunities.

## Case Studies & Featured Systems in Production

- [MEMORA](https://universo693.com/casos/memora): Digital memorials SaaS with AI-assisted life biography drafting, ceremony QR plaques, multi-gateway payments, and Android app.

- [Software a medida vs. suscripción](https://universo693.com/blog/software-a-medida-vs-suscripcion): When to build custom software vs. when to use off-the-shelf SaaS.
- [Inteligencia artificial en tu empresa: 5 casos prácticos](https://universo693.com/blog/inteligencia-artificial-en-tu-empresa-casos-practicos): Concrete AI adoption without losing operational control.
